Maximum likelihood for a compartmental model under the Gaussian approximation

Source: R/ga_fit.R
ga_fit.Rd

Maximises ga_loglik() over the parameters in start, on an unconstrained scale (logarithms of positive parameters, logits of those in unit), by a Nelder-Mead search (relative tolerance 1e-8) from each starting point followed by BFGS refinement of the best optimum. Parameters in fixed are held at their values.

Usage

ga_fit(
  model,
  data,
  obs,
  N,
  init,
  start,
  fixed = list(),
  unit = NULL,
  blocks = NULL,
  Delta = 1,
  nsub = 10L,
  hessian = TRUE,
  maxit = 1500
)

Arguments

model

A ga_model().

data

Matrix or data frame of counts, one column per element of obs (in the same order), one row per interval. NA marks a missing count.

obs

List of ga_incidence() / ga_prevalence() streams.

N

Population size.

init

A function of the parameter list returning the named vector of initial fractions, e.g. function(p) c(S = 1 - p$i0, I = p$i0, R = 0, D = 0).

start

Named list of starting values of the free parameters, or a list of such lists (several starts). A parameter listed in blocks takes a vector with one value per block (a scalar is recycled).

fixed

Named list of parameters held fixed.

unit

Names of free parameters constrained to (0, 1). By default, the reporting probabilities named in obs and any free parameter whose name ends in 0 (initial fractions such as i0).

blocks

Optional named list giving, for a time-varying rate parameter, an integer vector with the block (1, ..., B) of each observation interval; the parameter then takes one value per block.

Delta

Length of the observation interval.

nsub

Runge-Kutta steps per interval.

hessian

Logical; compute the numerical Hessian at the optimum.

maxit

Iteration limit of each Nelder-Mead run.

Value

An object of class ga_fit with elements coef (estimates on the natural scale, block-specific values named name[b]), loglik, convergence (the optim code of the final run), par and hessian (unconstrained scale), vcov (on that scale), starts (log-likelihood reached from each start) and the inputs needed by ga_profile(), confint.ga_fit() and predict.ga_fit().
